title: Filter Controller type registry and field-source foundation
purpose: Add the shared registry and binding contract needed before deeper style cadence and dynamic tag work.
objective: Create a small reusable foundation that reduces duplicated type logic and makes field source/key handling explicit.
scope_boundary: In scope: PHP registry metadata, binding resolver, normalized preset fields, editor metadata exposure, backward-compatible settings normalization, and implementation documentation. Out of scope: full CPT dynamic tag provider, resolver source semantics rewrite, and per-filter visual polish.
entry_condition: PHASE-FC-006 audit and synthesis are complete.
exit_condition: TASK-FC-045 is implemented, validated, documented, and committed in the plugin repository.
completion_criteria: Registry metadata exists for search, checkbox, radio, select, chips, toggle, range, date, swatch, and rating.
Binding resolution is centralized outside FilterSettings.
Preset sanitization preserves legacy fields and adds normalized source/resolved-key fields.
Editor localized config exposes metadata needed for later style cadence.

phases.title: Registry
phases.purpose: Centralize filter type labels, source needs, style families, and option/range/date/rating flags.

phases.title: Binding resolver
phases.purpose: Centralize manual, plain binding, and dynamic binding key resolution.

phases.title: Persistence bridge
phases.purpose: Persist normalized field source and resolved key while keeping legacy fields compatible.

phases.title: Verification
phases.purpose: Validate syntax, schemas, and plugin behavior boundaries.

acceptance_criteria: No existing field key path is removed.
No public REST route or capability check is weakened.
The foundation is usable by later style-cadence and dynamic-tag tasks.
verification: PHP lint passes for changed PHP files.
JS syntax check passes for changed JS files.
stop_conditions: The implementation starts redesigning individual filters.
A preset migration is required but not documented.
Dynamic tag behavior is claimed without local source evidence.
